summary: 14 ranked options. Standouts: Columbia River Classic local 10-mile race, Bend Snow & Avalanche Workshop, Victory Cup night cyclocross, Frontier Park cyclocross, and Never Ending Nolte six-hour. OpenSnow reports a possible PNW mountain snow shift Nov 13–15; resort skiing and snowmobile access not verified. Mount Rainier Sunrise and Stevens Canyon roads closed for the season. Organizer registration and point weather should be checked before departure.

recommendations.title: Columbia River Classic 10-Mile & 2-Mile
recommendations.weather: Typical mid-November cold morning; current point forecast not verified
recommendations.description: 51st annual flat paved river-path race; Friday packet pickup and race-day late registration offered. Online registration ends Nov 10.
recommendations.why: Best local organized running event; useful sustained-tempo effort before Gilbert half marathon.

recommendations.title: Bend Snow & Avalanche Workshop
recommendations.location: Central Oregon Community College, Bend, OR
recommendations.weather: Indoor event; Cascades snow possible on drive
recommendations.description: Central Oregon Avalanche Center's annual workshop; tickets listed by organizer.
recommendations.why: High-value preseason avalanche and ski-mountaineering education.

recommendations.title: Victory Cup Night Cyclocross & XC 5K
recommendations.description: Official Portland Trophy Cup night event; steep pitches, run-ups and optional cross-country run on CX course.
recommendations.why: Unusual evening racing and a strong cyclocross-season outing.

recommendations.title: Cross Revolution #4 Frontier Park
recommendations.description: St Jude's Classic CX event; BikeReg pre-registration closes Fri Nov 13 at 10 AM PT.
recommendations.why: Organized Pacific Northwest cyclocross with masters categories.

recommendations.title: Pomeroy SoleKids Fall Frenzy 5K
recommendations.description: Community 5K confirmed in UltraSignup newsletter; registration closes Fri Nov 13 11:59 PM PT.
recommendations.why: Nearby social race and an opportunity to support youth running.

recommendations.title: Never Ending Nolte 6-Hour
recommendations.weather: Cold and possibly wet; packed dirt/gravel
recommendations.description: Six-hour loop event on roughly 1.4-mile crushed gravel and dirt circuit; confirm organizer registration.
recommendations.why: Time-on-feet ultra preparation with minimal technical risk.

recommendations.title: Mingus Mayhem 9-Hour
recommendations.weather: Coastal rain and wet trails possible
recommendations.description: Nine-hour loop challenge on approximately 1.12-mile park trail, about 140 feet of climb per lap.
recommendations.why: Exceptional longer-distance option only if a destination ultra is the priority.

recommendations.title: Seattle International Randonneurs 161K
recommendations.description: Calendar lists 161-km populaire, tentatively Snohomish–La Conner out-and-back; verify final route and registration.

recommendations.title: Walla Walla Valley Gravel Ride
recommendations.weather: Check wind, rain and gravel mud
recommendations.description: Self-guided lowland gravel outing; no organized event confirmed.
recommendations.why: Reliable nearby gravel option without a race commitment.

recommendations.title: Badger–Candy Mountain Trail Long Run
recommendations.description: Build a 10–20-mile route linking foothill trails and climbing repeats; respect posted trail conditions.
recommendations.why: Supports March 50-mile ultra buildup without travel.

recommendations.title: Raging River MTB Conditions-Permitting Ride
recommendations.weather: Rain and freeze-thaw possible; confirm trails
recommendations.description: Ride established trails only if conditions allow; no specific organized event confirmed.
recommendations.why: Destination MTB if lowland trail surfaces remain rideable.

recommendations.title: Bend / Sisters Lower-Elevation MTB
recommendations.description: Prefer lower-elevation trails only after checking snow and freeze-thaw; can pair with Saturday avalanche workshop.
recommendations.why: Combine education and riding in one weekend.

recommendations.title: Walla Walla Winery Weekend
recommendations.description: Flexible food and wine stop; no special weekend festival independently verified.
recommendations.why: Low-logistics social weekend alongside a run or ride.

recommendations.title: Columbia River Trail Endurance Ride
recommendations.exceptional: Flat riverfront road/path riding; observe mixed-use trail rules.
recommendations.description: Convenient sustained endurance ride if mountain weather is poor.
